email.subject: Quick fix for Coral Works' site
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I looked at Coral Works Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no online booking option, so anyone checking after close has to wait and call, and your hours aren't listed, so people can't tell if you're open before they drive over.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's missing and what it'd take to fix?

No pressure either way.

Alex
